title: Records retire only when a confidence bound rules out worthwhile benefit
body:
Astra audit B1 (verified by running Fisher on 1/30 vs 2/10: p=0.1488, retire=true): src/brain/retire.ts:49-63 retires a record when the effect is not significant (RETIRE_P=0.1), which retires records with a plausible benefit on thin data.
Files: src/brain/retire.ts, test/brain/retirement-margin.test.ts
Outcome: a record retires only when the upper confidence bound of its benefit is below a stated margin; 1/30 served vs 2/10 withheld is kept; a large sample with no effect retires.
Proof: node --test test/brain/retirement-margin.test.ts passes with both cases.
